# Current opportunities

Interested in joining the lab? Open positions, if available, will be posted below:

> No current opportunities - check back soon!

As a lab, we aspire to create a diverse community that welcomes people of different races, cultures, ages, genders, sexuality, religions, socioeconomic levels, political perspectives, abilities, opinions, values and experiences.

## Undergraduate Research

Are you an undergraduate student at WWU interested in research? Get in touch!

## Graduate Opportunities

Curious about grad school? Interested in a master's degree in Environmental Science? You can [email me (Kate)](mailto:khayes23@alaska.edu). Before you do, take a look through the lab website, especially the research page. Be prepared to talk about why you'd like to go to graduate school, and why you'd like to work with me in particular.

I'm also happy to talk about, develop and collaborate on proposals for independent funding proposals for the [NSF GRFP](https://www.nsfgrfp.org/) and others.
